summary: Comprehensive testing of Dynamic Drink Pairings feature. All backend APIs working correctly: POST /api/recipes/detailed returns cuisine-specific drink pairings (Thai: Coconut Water, Thai Iced Tea, Riesling; Italian: Barolo, Pinot Grigio; Indian: Mango Lassi, Riesling). Frontend Recipe Detail Modal correctly parses drink pairings from markdown bullet format and displays them in the Drinks tab with Non-Alcoholic and Alcoholic sections. No generic fallback drinks shown.

minor.issue: Old cached recipes (Pad Thai, Spaghetti Carbonara, Butter Chicken) don't have drink pairings section because they were cached before the feature was added. New recipes work correctly.
